verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance SaaS platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted, on-premises or source-available deployment. The pack instead describes a vendor-hosted platform: users are invited and log in, and customers allowlist Thoropass IP addresses so its monitors and integrations can reach their systems.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
